scope: Current-state recognition diagnostic only; no future-state learning, control changes, or LTL success claim
diagnostic_D_status: Previously observed D, independent of training but not a new blind test
selection: Minimum unweighted mean three-predicate BCE on C tune; checkpoint every 5 epochs
calibration: C calibration only; per-predicate tau grid .5,.6,.7,.8,.85,.9,.95,.975,.99,.995; largest coverage subject to known assertion error<=5%, at least20 known assertions; held additionally FPR<=1% over all valid negative cases; report achieved coverage and diagnostic uncertainty, not certification

success_criteria.absolute: D diagnostic each predicate balanced accuracy>=.90, held raw FPR<=.02, calibrated known error<=.05 and coverage>=.70
success_criteria.relative: Direct improves macro balanced accuracy >=.02 OR known coverage >=.10 versus matched eight-class at known error<=.05; held FPR does not increase by >.01
success_criteria.limitations: Criteria are preregistered diagnostic gates, not evidence of statistically guaranteed success or novel-object generalization

entity_interface: Entity handle selects visible ROI; no learned color index. Shared object encoder, shared temporal GRU and shared held/in heads. Drawer relation target is only fixed drawer; new containers and predicates untested. Color registration currently only red/blue/pink.
loss: Unweighted cross entropy eight categories + three drawer categories versus per-predicate BCE, same trunk/input/order/seeds. No label smoothing or class resampling.
extension: Exclude every pink held/in or eight-class label in auxiliary direct training; context may still show pink. Evaluate known appearance with unlabelled entity only, not unseen new object.
confusion_gap: No near-gripper-not-held negatives in AB boundary data; only 2 in C tune and2 in D; no targeted mid-action confusion collection in this bounded diagnostic. Drawer intermediate class absent.
